entries.notes: (located on 20 acres in Unger, WV, between Berkeley Springs, WV and Winchester, VA). We publish a newsletter for lesbians called Mountain Laurel and sponsor concerts featuring grassroots women performers through Rural Women's Productions. Semi-vegetarian, non-smoking. No drugs or alcohol. Please bring food to share.

entries.notes: We have lived here 2 1/2 years. Our garden is reclaimed tobacco cropland. Our border is a beautiful little river where we skinny-dip after working. We live in a trailer and school bus at the end of a gravel road. Our land is beautiful, mostly wooded, secluded, yet just 12 miles to town. One of us is a park ranger, the other an artist.

entries.notes: Silver Circle Sanctuary, located in north Mississippi, is a beautiful part of the Mother we are reclaiming from the patriarchy. Two of us living on the land are exploring our spirituality, gardening with the Devas for the first time. One wommon moving on her journey wishes to sell her cabin. We are into enjoying the bounties of the great spirit, the Mother. We try to walk the walk; we've struggled against the patriarchy inside ourselves. We are organic, nonsmoking, sober, nonchemical, over forty.

entries.welcomed_groups: We welcome: visitors, girl children, well-behaved dogs, organic gardeners, non-toxic builders.
entries.notes: We are two lesbian homesteaders in the Arkansas Ozark mountains. We've begun our passive solar and nontoxic house although we had no previous building experience. This spring we're working on our 1/4 acre organic garden hoping to support ourselves as market gardeners. We live with both dogs and cats. Both of us are nonsmokers and lacto-ovarian vegetarians. Alcohol, drugs not welcome. Primitive camping is available - access requires a truck or our assistance up the mountains.

entries.land_description: rural land outside of Kanab (southern Utah). Working on non-toxic, wheelchair accessible structures, a water system, solar electricity, solid accessible pathways over the soft pink sand. Gorgeous canyons all around, deer, coyotes and eagles.
entries.welcomed_groups: We welcome: visitors, possible new members/residents, girl children, nonlesbian women.
entries.notes: Open lesbian land for womyn with Environmental Illness/chemical, scent, etc, allergies and unscented womyn friends. Just started 2/88... Primarily goal: a place where womyn with EI can be social, carry on our lives without fear of bug-dope, perfume, or the latest in cleansers. Chem-free. Sign language is spoken here. We have: camping space, women living and working on the land.

entries.welcomed_groups: We welcome: visitors, girl/boy children, nonlesbian women.
entries.notes: (located on Albion Ridge Rd about 6 miles up). We are 3-4 sharing this land. In addition to one common house with kitchen and bath, we each now have our own spaces. Mostly we live our own separate lives, sometimes seeing each other in passing and at irregular ongoing meetings. We are not a "group" as such. Many ideals and expectations of collectivity have fallen away in the face of personalities and process. But life goes on, and for me it gets better, as more and more I come home to myself, loving myself and other women. On the land, the trees keep growing; it looks like another dry year. But life too will go on...
